mostWorthwhile.text: Forming the gas giant was most worthwhile: the explanation of its cooling envelope clarified how it could keep gathering gas.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial dust-and-stone combination was predictable, with only one gameplay action offered.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; each followed the formation sequence, although the single-option menus left little choice.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see what happens when the rubble world and giant approach, though the linear choices were less engaging than the explanations.
